contentBody.description: Identify the business outcome or challenge the customer is trying to solve for and discuss + document the customers evaluation criteria which would result in a Generative AI solution landing on Intel

sections.content:
Ask the customer questions around criteria and metrics they will require which could result in a Gaudi purchase.

  • Performance / cost competitiveness
  • Specific performance levels
  • Compatibility with required models
  • Ease of use
sections.keyConcept: Discuss evaluation criteria with the customer

sections.content: Through the Assess Phase details and the above questions, define the key Business Outcome for your customer's LLM opportunity.
